async def parse_detail(page, detail_url):
    await page.goto(detail_url)
    pdf_links = await page.query_selector_all('a[href$=".pdf"]')
    pdf_urls = [await link.get_attribute('href') for link in pdf_links]
    return {'pdf_urls': pdf_urls}
